title: Balanced ischemia: SPECT, PET and angiography
summary: SPECT appears without perfusion abnormality while oxygen-15 water PET reveals widespread stress perfusion deficits; angiography confirms severe disease, described as balanced ischemia.
text:
SPECT appears without perfusion abnormality while oxygen-15 water PET reveals widespread stress perfusion deficits; angiography confirms severe disease, described as balanced ischemia.

Panel A shows tetrofosmin SPECT with no apparent perfusion abnormality in the source case. Panel B shows extensive H2-15O PET stress perfusion deficits that partly improve at rest. Panel C shows source-marked severe coronary stenoses. The comparison illustrates this case's balanced ischemia.
